contract: The reconstructed uniform-resampling, per-worker queue scheduler must reproduce both reported average oracle-call times within absolute tolerance 0.015 over three deterministic long-horizon seeds.
negative_control: A homogeneous-style scheduler that only reschedules the completing worker must lie outside tolerance for both delays.
scope: Scheduler fidelity only. Passing cannot verify the 1.2x/1.3x training speedups.
